requirement: Parse a key=value settings file, and provide a test helper that patches open so each known path yields its own text and unknown paths raise FileNotFoundError.
skeleton: read_settings iterating the opened file with numbered lines, skipping blanks and comments and partitioning on the first equals sign; fake_files contextmanager patching builtins.open with a side_effect returning per-path mock_open handles.
caption: File-reading code tested with unittest.mock instead of real files. read_settings(path) opens the path with encoding utf-8 and walks its lines with enumerate starting at 1, stripping each one and skipping blank lines and lines starting with #. Every other line is split with str.partition on the first equals sign, so values may themselves contain equals signs; a line without an equals sign or with a blank key raises ValueError formatted as path:line: expected key=value. Keys and values are stripped and a later key overrides an earlier one. fake_files(contents) is a contextlib.contextmanager that patches builtins.open with a side_effect function and yields the patch mock, so callers can assert how open was called. For a path in the mapping the function returns a fresh mock_open handle whose read_data is that path's text, which supports iteration; any other path raises FileNotFoundError naming it, just like a missing file. The fixture asserts that comments and blank lines are skipped and open was called once with encoding utf-8, that a URL value keeps its equals signs, that a malformed second line raises ValueError naming app.cfg:2, that a blank key raises ValueError, that two paths read their own text with call_count 2, and that an unknown path raises FileNotFoundError.

plan.intent: Test file parsing without touching the disk
constraints: Blank lines and # comments are skipped
Malformed lines and blank keys raise ValueError with path and line number
Each fake path reads its own text
open is called with encoding utf-8

rationale.teaches: patch('builtins.open', side_effect=...) returning mock_open(read_data=...) handles per path, so iteration and missing files behave like the real filesystem.
rationale.why: A single global mock_open hides which file was read and turns missing files into empty ones, so path bugs and error handling go untested.

ops.docstring: Patch open with per-path mock_open handles to test file-reading code.

ops.stmt: from unittest.mock import MagicMock, mock_open, patch

candidates.why_wrong: rpartition splits on the last equals sign, so values containing equals signs are cut.
Line numbers start at zero, so errors point at the previous line.
Comment lines are parsed as settings and rejected as malformed.
A line with a blank key is stored under the empty string instead of raising.
Unknown paths read as empty files instead of raising FileNotFoundError.
